# netbox_virtual_machine_interface (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/virtualization/#interfaces):

> Virtual machine interfaces behave similarly to device interfaces, and can be assigned to VRFs, and may have IP addresses, VLANs, and services attached to them. However, given their virtual nature, they lack properties pertaining to physical attributes. For example, VM interfaces do not have a physical type and cannot have cables attached to them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Assume Netbox already has a VM whos name matches 'dc-west-myvm-20'
data "netbox_virtual_machine" "myvm" {
  name_regex = "dc-west-myvm-20"
}

resource "netbox_virtual_machine_interface" "myvm_eth0" {
  name               = "eth0"
  virtual_machine_id = data.netbox_virtual_machine.myvm.id
}

// Assume existing VLAN resources 'test1' and 'test2'
resource "netbox_virtual_machine_interface" "myvm_eth1" {
  name               = "eth1"
  enabled            = true
  mac_address        = "00:16:3E:A8:B5:D7"
  mode               = "tagged"
  mtu                = 1440
  tagged_vlans       = [netbox_vlan.test1.id]
  untagged_vlan      = netbox_vlan.test2.id
  virtual_machine_id = netbox_virtual_machine.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the interface.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual machine associated with the interface.

### Optional

- `bridge_interface_id` (Number) ID of the bridge interface this interface belongs to.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the interface.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the interface is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `mode` (String) Valid values are `access`, `tagged` and `tagged-all`.
- `mtu` (Number) The MTU of the interface.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the interface. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `parent` (Number) The parent of the interface.
- `qinq_svlan_id` (Number) The ID of the qinq svlan associated with the interface.
- `tagged_vlans` (Set of Number) The tagged vlans of the interface.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `type` (String, Deprecated) The type of the interface.
- `untagged_vlan` (Number) The untagged vlan of the interface.
- `vlan_translation_policy_id` (Number) The ID of the vlan translation policy associated with the interface.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the vrf associated with the interface.

### Read-Only

- `count_fhrp_groups` (Number) The count fhrp groups of the virtual machine interface.
- `count_ipaddresses` (Number) The count ipaddresses of the virtual machine interface.
- `created` (String) When the virtual machine interface was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `l2vpn_termination_id` (Number) The ID of the l2vpn termination associated with the virtual machine interface.
- `last_updated` (String) When the virtual machine interface was last changed.
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the interface.
- `primary_mac_address_id` (Number) The primary MAC address id.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_virtual_machine_interface.example 1
```
